data.title: 五更琉璃 · 晨风窗纱下的安宁拥吻
data.description: 清晨的微风拂动纯白窗纱，姬发式黑发如墨色铺散在枕头两旁。初醒的五更琉璃像只慵懒的小黑猫，闭着双眼用鼻尖亲昵蹭着你的锁骨，嘴角噙着沉醉在现世极乐里的安宁甜笑。
data.location: sun-drenched bedroom with billowing white sheer curtains
data.action: tangled in white morning duvet, black hime cut spread across pillow, sleepily nuzzling partner collarbone with a radiant peaceful smile in morning sun
data.lighting: bright warm morning sunshine illuminating pale porcelain skin
data.mood: morning newlywed serenity, tranquil eternal romance, sweet kitten girlfriend cuddles
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets with black hime cut spread on pillow, Ruri Gokou sleepily nuzzles partner collarbone with a radiant peaceful smile.
data.animaCaption: Ruri Gokou nuzzling partner peacefully in morning sheets.
